crc32_admin_forge.description:
The integrity of a message is protected with a CRC32 checksum. CRC32 is a linear checksum, not a MAC, so a 4-byte suffix can be forged.
message (hex) = 757365723d616c69636526726f6c653d757365722661646d696e3d30
crc32 = 7c87d463
target = deadbeef
Append exactly 4 bytes to the message so that CRC32(message || suffix) equals the target.
Submit the 4 appended bytes as flag{<8 hex>}.
